provider.provider_scope: Structure validation, asset verification, worker startup, model loading and inference; excludes installation, downloads and workflow orchestration

timing.scope: Fresh workflow; model worker starts per call. Existing installation/model assets and OS file cache; installation/download cold cost unmeasured.
